examples.title: The simplified form omits the unknown February value
Keep all six cells, including the unknown one
Choose a stable column order for the report
examples.sql:
PIVOT long_sales ON month IN ('jan', 'feb', 'mar')
USING sum(amount) GROUP BY region ORDER BY region;

sampleSpecs.title: A familiar spreadsheet shape
sampleSpecs.description: North February is unknown. South March is a real zero. Each region has one source row.

challenge.title: Find the missing measurement
challenge.prompt: Return region and month for the unknown measurement in long_sales. Do not include a recorded zero.
challenge.hint: NULL and zero express different facts. Test the original amount with IS NULL.
challenge.starter: SELECT region, month FROM long_sales WHERE coalesce(amount, 0) = 0 ORDER BY region, month;
challenge.solution: SELECT region, month FROM long_sales WHERE amount IS NULL ORDER BY region, month;
challenge.success: North’s February value is unknown. South’s March value is known to be zero.
